page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top with page number at top right. Two poem blocks: first a title heading and a six-line epigram; then a second heading and a longer poem with a long-s-free italic style and initial capitals. No margin notes.

main_text.head: PAVLO QVARTO, Pontifici Romano.

p.i: Pane quaqua Paulus contentus vixerat olim,
Quum traheret rubra fyrmata longa toga:
Hic idem ingluuiem dapibus nunc pascit opimis,
Cuius nunc tnerat terna tiara caput.
Iussisti esse lupum qui fuit ante canis.

main_text.head: IN ROMAM, Poemate Germani Audeberti Aurelij Pulcherrimè descri ptum:
main_text.p: Saxea qua fuerat, caelumque folumq; lacesses, Et mole iam grauis fua, Conciderat, solisque dia vifenda ruina Semet iacebat obruens.

Hac (mirum dictu) chartacea facta refurgit, Tantoque fiat vivacior, Artificum quanto cunctorum scalpra, poeta Morti domitrix vincit manus: Marmoraque exuperant quanto pradura tabellae Vatum exarata pollice.

p.i: Struxeris ergo tuae simulachrum, Romule, Roma, Augusle, quod poliueris:
At (vestra lteeat mihi dicere pace Qurites) Romam Audebertus condidit.

page.notes: Printed text is partly damaged and faint in places. Doubtful readings: "Pane quaqua" (likely Pane quia, or Pane quia/quaqua), "Quum", "fyrmata" (purpurata), "tnerat" (enerat), "Saxea qua", "dia vifenda" (diua visenda), "pradura" (praedura), "Augusle" (Augusto). Words marked in the transcription remain unverified. The fourth-line stanza was partly unreadable and is transcribed as best as possible.
